claims.statement: Immutable approval requests retain the exact action, authorization-set epoch, Run, plan, step, policy, requester snapshot, bounded times, safe destination, and redacted payload projection; purpose-specific keyed corruption-detection digests cover request lifecycle, decision, and use facts before hydration, which also rejects coercion, projection canaries, contradictions, and partial sets.

For an already-persisted validated write plan, RUN-05 action creation, the complete PROPOSED-to-AWAITING_APPROVAL action set, generation-one approval requests, and their redacted audit witnesses commit in one unit of work; semantic replay returns original action, request, set, runtime-step, and time identities, while partial rows or audit gaps are never healed.

The persistence port gives an exactly bound pending decision one winner and atomically advances its action; public expiry and same-action leaf renewal use optimistic action/request fences, append request and action-reopen audit witnesses in the same transaction, preserve one set-level proposal_revision, return the original linked replacement on replay, and normalize SQLite writer races to typed conflicts.

Approval decision and use rows have portable exact composite bindings to their request, action, set, Run, plan, revision, step, reservation, and reservation time; SQLite constraints and hydration reject cross-scope or time tampering, and every mapped table compiles for SQLite and PostgreSQL.

A request leaf may renew only after expiry for the unchanged exact action, policy, membership, plan, and proposal_revision; semantic, plan, or membership change fails with full_set_epoch_required because selecting and superseding an entirely new complete authorization-set epoch is deliberately owned by ORCH-08.

limitations: RUN-08 stores typed requester, decision actor, authentication-method, correlation, role, and scope snapshots but does not authenticate or authorize them. API-06 and RUN-10 must derive those values from a server-owned authenticated principal and own the public decision service plus approved/rejected audit events.

ApprovalUse has an exact durable schema and fail-closed hydration contract only. ORCH-08 owns complete-current-set reservation and batch consumption, use insertion, one-time barrier release, parent Run/step fencing, cancellation validity, and every connector-call decision; RUN-08 exposes no per-leaf consume mutation.

proposal_revision is a set-level epoch. RUN-08 permits expiry-only leaf replacement for the unchanged action/set/epoch, but ORCH-08 must add an authorization-set head and atomically create and select every member of a new epoch before semantic, plan, or membership replacement can supersede the old set.

ApprovalRecordService composes action and request records against an already-persisted validated plan. AuditedPlanPersistenceService still rejects write plans, so atomic Run/plan/step/action/request activation remains ORCH-08 composition scope rather than a RUN-08 claim.

RUN-08 stores the safe projection but does not expose an operator API projection. API-06/API-07 retain transport and presentation ownership, and DEL-04 retains database migration and upgrade ownership.

Deployment composition must inject the configured restart-stable root DigestKey. Fixed approval-request, decision, and use HMAC domains are distinct from admission-digest domains; key distribution and rotation are configuration/DEL-04 scope, and these digests detect corruption but do not authenticate actors.

Runtime races and constraints are exercised on file-backed SQLite. PostgreSQL table DDL is compiled for portability, but PostgreSQL concurrency execution requires its integration environment before a runtime parity claim.
